lines.zh: 我弯着腰走，钩子垂在身侧。
lines.en: I walk hunched, the hook hanging at my side.

lines.zh: 我的步子很快，身体却歪着。
lines.en: I go quickly, though my body is slanted.
I push out from behind the curtain.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙走，不发出脚步声。
lines.en: I keep to the wall without a footfall.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，地毯被抓开了。
lines.en: The carpet is torn where I pass.

lines.zh: 我一直偏着头，看着前面。
lines.en: I keep my head cocked, watching ahead.

lines.zh: 我从走廊那头过来，很快。
lines.en: I come down the corridor quickly.
Patches of my casing hang loose.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，像随时要冲。
lines.en: I keep low, as if ready to bolt.
I advance in little lunges.
My hook catches the lamp.
I circle the stage without stopping.

lines.zh: 我站着，脚一直在地板上磨。
lines.en: I stand, one foot scraping the floor.
My head stays cocked to one side.
There are only a few teeth left in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我在听，听走廊里的动静。
lines.en: I am listening to the corridor.
My casing creaks, faintly.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢站着，我喜欢冲。
lines.en: I do not like standing; I like to lunge.

lines.zh: 灯光照不到我站的这个角落。
lines.en: The lamp does not reach this corner.
With my head cocked, I look almost amused.

lines.zh: 我身上的布条一直垂着。
lines.en: The strips of cloth hang off me.

lines.zh: 我把头扭过来，正对着你。
lines.en: I twist my head around to face you.
Do not even think of bolting.

lines.zh: 我抬起钩子，指了一下你。
lines.en: I raise the hook and point it at you.
I lean forward a little.
I cocked my head and stared a long while.
Your feet have already started moving.

lines.zh: 我想听你跑起来的声音。
lines.en: I want to hear you run.
The lamp has not found me here.

lines.zh: 我的外壳凹了，我还在往前。
lines.en: My casing dents, and I keep coming.

lines.zh: 里面有什么断了，声音很闷。
lines.en: Something inside snaps with a dull sound.
My head tilts a little further.
I give one step, then come right back.
I make no sound, only stare.
My hook swings twice.
That cost me half a second.
A strip of cloth falls to the floor.
My feet have not stopped.
I do not eat that.
You hold it up, and all I want is to lunge.
I am not hungry; I want to move.
Put it down, then run.
That cannot make blood.
I tipped my head to one side.
You hold on to this.
I have no use for supplies.
Everyone in this room has run off.
You are more interesting than that.
You hit me and I barely move.

lines.zh: 我的外壳硬，撞上去没用。
lines.en: My casing is hard; hitting it is useless.
I use the knock to get to your flank.
That only brought me closer.

lines.zh: 我的钩子擦过你的袖子。
lines.en: My hook grazes your sleeve.
I have got my feet steady again.
You pull back and I come forward.
Do not block the doorway.

lines.zh: 我歪着脑袋继续压过去。
lines.en: I pressed on with my head cocked.
I have no such program.
I only run and grab.
I eye you with the one eye I have.

lines.zh: 幕布后面没有别的玩偶。
lines.en: There is no other animatronic behind the curtain.
I turned my back.
My hook moves once.
I set my head straight, then let it tilt again.
I have nothing to say.
I head off down the corridor.
I hook it up.
I fling it aside.
My fingers are not enough.
I squeeze and it flattens.
I do not know this.
I hang it on the hook.
Could this be a weapon?
I threw it straight back.
I straighten up at once.
I heard you run.
I bolt without hesitating.
My hook is up.
I drop low, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪儿，我都追得到。
lines.en: Wherever you run, I can follow.
I opened my mouth.
My casing scrapes the wall.
The light flickers, and I am still here.
I do not need to go slowly.
Go on, take a look back.
I raise the hook, then lower it.
That door is already locked.
I run after you, hook swinging.
You turn into the side hall, and I get faster.
I stay right behind you.
My footsteps come one after another.
The door you pushed is still open.
I cut through the vent.

lines.zh: 我的头歪着，跑起来更稳。
lines.en: My head is cocked, and I run steadier for it.

lines.zh: 你在拐角停了一下，我听出来了。
lines.en: You paused at the corner; I heard it.
The lamps go out one by one.
I know the way without looking.
I know this place better than you.
You run slower than I do.
I herd you toward the dead end.
The way behind the curtain is closed.

lines.zh: 我一直听得见你的呼吸。
lines.en: I can hear your breathing the whole time.
One more turn and it is the end.
Your breathing is getting heavier.
I never feel tired.

lines.zh: 我从旁边那条道绕过去了。
lines.en: I have gone around by the side passage.
This is where I lunge.
The hook comes down in a slash.

lines.zh: 我一扑，整个身体压上去。
lines.en: I spring, whole body behind it.
My teeth sink into your shoulder.
The hook catches; I haul back.
I slam into your chest.

lines.zh: 这一下很快，你来不及躲。
lines.en: That came fast; you had no time to dodge.

lines.zh: 我没有停，接着又来一下。
lines.en: I do not stop; another comes right after.
My casing hits the wall.
I have you trapped at the door.

lines.zh: 这一抓撕开了你的衣服。
lines.en: That claw tore your clothes open.

lines.zh: 你退后了，我立刻贴上去。
lines.en: You fall back, and I close in at once.
The hook is stuck in the wood.
I wrench it out and the wood splits.
You can still run; I do not like that.
I have you pinned down.
My mouth is full of cloth.
There is nowhere left for you.
I lift my head, then drop it again.

lines.zh: 幕布动了一下，我出来了。
lines.en: The curtain moves, and I am out.
Something moves at the end of the corridor.
My one eye lit first.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候几乎没有声音。
lines.en: I land almost silently.

lines.zh: 我把头从门框边探出来。
lines.en: I poke my head around the door frame.

lines.zh: 我的钩子先出现在光下。
lines.en: My hook appears in the light first.
I crawl out from under the stage.

lines.zh: 灯照到我的时候，我已经站好了。
lines.en: By the time the lamp finds me, I am already up.
The door of this room has opened.
Strips of cloth hang off my casing.
The corridor is very empty tonight.

lines.zh: 火点着了我身上的布，我甩了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches the cloth on me; I shake it twice.

lines.zh: 落地时我的一条腿响了一声。
lines.en: On landing, one of my legs cracks.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的外壳，我的动作卡住了。
lines.en: Water floods my casing and my movement seizes.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀在地上，钩子飞了出去。
lines.en: The blast flattens me and the hook goes flying.

lines.zh: 一股力把我的关节锁住。
lines.en: Some force locks my joints.
I do not hunger, yet I am slowing.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整个外壳都在抖。
lines.en: Lightning hits and my whole casing shakes.

lines.zh: 地板没了，我什么也抓不到。
lines.en: The floor is gone and I have nothing to grip.
